等额本息：A = P × r × (1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n−1)。r: Equal installments: A = P × r × (1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n−1), where r is the monthly interest rate. At zero interest, A=P/n.
等额本金：每期本金约为P/n，利息为当期期初剩余本金乘月利率；最后一期调整分位尾: Equal principal: each principal repayment is approximately P/n; interest is the opening outstanding balance multiplied by the monthly rate. The final installment settles rounding differences.
累计预扣：当月预扣税额依据累计应纳税所得额及此前已预扣税款计算；年度汇算单独列示: Cumulative withholding: monthly tax uses cumulative taxable income and previously withheld tax. Annual settlement is reported separately.
组合贷：两笔贷款分别计算本金、利息及余额，再按期合并；公积金还贷提取另记账户流转: Combined loans: principal, interest and balances are calculated separately for each loan, then combined by installment. Provident-fund withdrawals are recorded separately as account transfers.
